record.original_question: Let n X P (z) = ak z k be a self-inversive polynomial, i.e. if ζ is a zero of P (ζ) with multiplicity m, then 1/ζ is also a zero with multiplicity m. Is it true that w = P (z) maps D onto a domain containing a disc of radius A = max0≤k≤n |ak |? (T. Sheil-Small)

evidence.quote: Let n X P (z) = ak z k be a self-inversive polynomial, i.e. if ζ is a zero of P (ζ) with multiplicity m, then 1/ζ is also a zero with multiplicity m.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A polynomial $P(z)=\sum_{k=0}^n a_k z^k$ with complex coefficients (and $a_n\neq 0$) is called self-inversive if, whenever $\zeta\in\mathbb{C}\setminus\{0\}$ is a zero of $P$ of multiplicity $m$, then $1/\overline{\zeta}$ is also a zero of $P$ of multiplicity $m$ (equivalently, $P(z)=\varepsilon z^n\overline{P(1/\overline{z})}$ for some unimodular constant $\varepsilon$). Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disc, and set
\[ A := \max_{0\le k\le n} |a_k|. \]
Decide whether the following statement is true: for every self-inversive polynomial $P$ of degree $n\ge 1$, the image $P(\mathbb{D})$ contains a disc of radius $A$ (centered at some point of $\mathbb{C}$).
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return any source explicitly resolving Sheil-Small's question about whether the image under the unit disc of a self-inversive polynomial must contain a disc of radius equal to the maximum modulus of its coefficients. The problem is referenced in the literature on self-inversive polynomials and in Sheil-Small's "Complex Polynomials," but no proof or counterexample was located.

status_evidence.title: Complex Polynomials - T. Sheil-Small
status_evidence.snippet: Sheil-Small's book discusses self-inversive polynomials and related geometric questions about images of polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: The problem belongs to a circle of questions on self-inversive polynomials studied by Sheil-Small; no resolution is mentioned.

status_evidence.title: Self-inversive polynomials, curves, and codes
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of properties of self-inversive polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: No statement of resolution of the covering-disc question is given.
